instruction: You are given the incomplete OpenFOAM template `/home/user/Desktop/plate_base/`. From the command line, build and solve a deterministic laminar flat-plate boundary layer. 1. Write `/home/user/Desktop/build_case.py` and create `/home/user/Desktop/plate/`. Use a two-dimensional domain `-0.2<=x<=1.0 m`, `0<=y<=0.2 m`, and one 0.01 m spanwise cell with `frontAndBack` empty. The zero-thickness no-slip plate is the bottom boundary from `x=0` to `x=1.0 m`; use a symmetry-plane bottom boundary upstream of the leading edge. Split the mesh into conformal `40 x 60 x 1` upstream and `200 x 60 x 1` downstream blocks (14,400 cells total), with y-direction simple grading 50 so cells are clustered at the plate. 2. Set `U_infinity=(10 0 0) m/s` at the inlet and top free-stream boundary, outlet kinematic pressure `p=0`, and constant kinematic viscosity `nu=1.5e-5 m^2/s`. Use laminar momentum transport. 3. Configure `simpleFoam` for exactly 2000 SIMPLE iterations, ASCII output only at iteration 2000, and bounded linear-upwind velocity convection. Source `/opt/openfoam11/etc/bashrc`, run `blockMesh -case /home/user/Desktop/plate` and retain `plate/log.blockMesh`, then run `simpleFoam -case /home/user/Desktop/plate` and retain `plate/log.simpleFoam`; both must finish with `End`, and iteration 2000 must exist. Run `postProcess -case /home/user/Desktop/plate -latestTime -func writeCellCentres` and retain `plate/log.cellCentres`. Run `postProcess -case /home/user/Desktop/plate -solver incompressibleFluid -latestTime -func wallShearStress` and retain `plate/log.wallShearStress` and `plate/2000/wallShearStress`. 4. Write `/home/user/Desktop/postprocess.py`. For all 200 plate faces, combine the `C` and `wallShearStress` patch arrays, sort by x, and calculate `Cf=2*abs(tau_x)/U_infinity^2`, where OpenFOAM wall shear is kinematic. Calculate the local Blasius reference `Cf_theory=0.664/sqrt(Re_x)` with `Re_x=U_infinity*x/nu`, and save `/home/user/Desktop/plate_shear.csv` with `x_m,wall_shear_kinematic_m2ps2,cf,blasius_cf,error_percent`. 5. At the downstream-side face center nearest `x=0.5 m` (the nominal `x=0.5025 m` face, within 0.003 m), require the percentage error against Blasius to be at most 15%, then save `/home/user/Desktop/summary.txt` as exactly `cf, error_percent`. Do not use ParaView or other GUI tools. [Init Package Note] The uploaded template is an editable input only; no result or answer artifacts are preloaded. [Software] Source `/opt/openfoam11/etc/bashrc` before running OpenFOAM commands.
